question: Which of the following is the most widely used method for refining impure metals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electrolytic Refining**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Electrolytic refining** is a technique employed for the **extraction and purification of impure metals** through electrolysis.
 
• In this process, the crude metal serves as the anode, while a strip of pure metal is utilized as the cathode, and a soluble salt of the same metal is employed as the electrolyt
